name: patient_has_finding_of_multiple_organ_failure_now@@early
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's multiple organ failure is early.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's multiple organ failure is early.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's multiple organ failure is not early.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's multiple organ failure is early.

name: patient_has_finding_of_multiple_organ_failure_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has multiple organ failure.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of multiple organ failure.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of multiple organ failure.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has multiple organ failure.

name: sequential_organ_failure_assessment_score_value_recorded_now_withunit_points
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's SOFA score at the current time, in points.
when_unknown: Set to null if the SOFA score is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined at the current time.
when_value: Set to the value of the patient's SOFA score (in points) as recorded at the current time.

name: patient_has_finding_of_alcohol_induced_acute_pancreatitis_now@@severe

when_false: Set to false if the patient's alcohol-induced acute pancreatitis is not severe.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's alcohol-induced acute pancreatitis is severe.
